key_highlights: ASX set to open lower as Wall Street slides on inflation fears; Fed chief reaffirms inflation fight, pressuring global risk assets
Australian interest rate expectations rocket, with mortgage rates rising week-on-week, signalling RBA may hold or hike
Housing market deteriorating sharply: home values decline in August, auction sentiment weakens, and household terminations rise
ASX closed the prior week higher despite volatility, showing resilience amid global headwinds
US strikes on Iranian launchers in Strait of Hormuz elevate geopolitical and oil-supply risk
Gateway Resources adds 7km gold trend in WA; Pilbara iron ore activity booms
Virgin Australia insulated from oil shock via fuel hedging and new fleet; Qantas faces workforce fallout
Labor's by-election vote collapse and WA dynamics shift add political uncertainty to policy outlook

sectors.trend: Pilbara iron ore activity surges; Gateway Resources (GWR.AX) adds 7km gold trend in WA; Bapcor and Metal Hawk among ASX runners. Commodity backdrop mixed with geopolitical oil risk.
sectors.implications: Positive for BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX on iron ore momentum; gold names (GWR.AX, NGM.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows amid US-Iran tensions.

sectors.trend: Rising rate expectations and higher mortgage rates support NIMs but pressure loan growth. Housing downturn threatens credit quality. Insurance sector under scrutiny over cash settlements.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from rate upside but face housing-linked credit risk. Insurance names (CGU.AX, WPA.AX) face regulatory pressure.

sectors.trend: US-Iran strike in Strait of Hormuz spikes oil risk premium. Virgin (QAN.AX) hedged against shock. Oil majors retreat from clean energy commitments. Victoria's offshore wind auction signals transition.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX benefit from oil volatility; QAN.AX insulated. Renewable names (SOL.AX, IGR.AX) gain from policy support but face capital intensity.

sectors.trend: Grocery prices rising; weight-loss drug demand surges; 'dupe' brand trend accelerates; EV uptake rising. Fruit grower lays off ~1,000 workers. Childcare sector in crisis.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. CSL.AX benefits from pharma demand. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: Housing values decline sharply; auction sentiment deteriorates; household terminations rise. Suburban Rail Loop cost overhang in Victoria weighs on infrastructure-linked REITs.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Infrastructure REITs exposed to SRL cost blowouts.

sectors.trend: AI power demand reshaping energy and industrial equities (CAT, Chevron). Australia sets 'high bar' for fossil-fuel-powered data centres. SpaceX disruption potential noted.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but energy-adjacent AI plays (SOL.AX, IGR.AX) gain. Data centre regulation may favour renewables.

key_themes: Inflation resurgence and rising rate expectations pressuring global and ASX equities
Australian housing market entering correction phase with falling values and weak auctions
Geopolitical escalation (US-Iran) elevating oil and risk-premium volatility
Political uncertainty from by-election results affecting policy confidence
AI-driven power demand reshaping energy and industrial investment thesis
Consumer cost-of-living pressure: grocery inflation, childcare crisis, insurance shortfalls

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / prolonged tight policy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; favour rate-sensitive banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX) with strong NIMs; underweight rate-sensitive REITs.
Reduce exposure to property REITs and construction names; monitor NIM and NPL trends at major banks.
Hedge with energy (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) and gold (GWR.AX, NGM.AX); maintain cash buffer.
Favour large-cap, dividend-paying ASX 20 names over small-caps; monitor by-election follow-through.
Overweight staples (WES.AX, WTW.AX) and healthcare (CSL.AX); underweight discretionary.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and iron ore miners on geopolitical risk and Pilbara momentum
opportunities.rationale: US-Iran tensions support gold; Pilbara activity surge underpins iron ore demand; GWR.AX discovery adds optionality

opportunities.recommendation: Add to major banks on rising rate expectations and NIM expansion
opportunities.rationale: Rising mortgage rates support earnings; credit risk manageable at current NPL levels

opportunities.recommendation: Position in energy names for oil volatility hedge
opportunities.rationale: Strait of Hormuz risk premium supports oil prices; Virgin hedged, but upstream names benefit

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property REIT and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing values declining, auction sentiment weak, household terminations rising; SRL cost overhang

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash and short-duration bonds as rate uncertainty persists
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising rate expectations and inflation risk create volatility; 4.30% CD yields offer attractive risk-free return
Cost-of-living pressure supports WES/WTW; weight-loss drug demand supports CSL; insurance regulatory risk a headwind

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to open lower on Monday amid Wall Street inflation-driven selloff. Volatility elevated by US-Iran tensions and rising RBA rate expectations. Housing data weakness may cap upside. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow range with sector rotation toward defensives and commodities.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA holds and global growth stabilises. Housing correction may moderate over time. AI power demand and energy transition provide structural themes. Political resolution post by-elections could restore policy confidence. Key risk: prolonged housing downturn dragging on credit and construction.
